WITH cct1 AS (
  SELECT id AS subject_id, kind AS status_id FROM comp_cast_type WHERE kind = 'cast' AND kind LIKE '%complete%'
), char_info AS (
  SELECT chn.name, ci.movie_id, ci.person_role_id, n.id AS person_id
  FROM char_name AS chn
    INNER JOIN cast_info AS ci ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
    INNER JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
  WHERE chn.name IS NOT NULL AND (chn.name LIKE '%man%' OR chn.name LIKE '%Man%')
), movie_info AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.title, it2.info, mk.movie_id, k.keyword
  FROM title AS t
    INNER JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id AND k.id = mk.keyword_id
    INNER JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.info = 'rating'
    INNER JOIN keyword AS k ON k.keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
    INNER JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON t.id = mi_idx.movie_id AND it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
  WHERE t.production_year > 2000 AND kt.kind = 'movie'
), complete_hero_movies AS (
  SELECT movie_id FROM complete_cast cc
    INNER JOIN cct1 ON cct1.subject_id = cc.subject_id AND cct1.status_id = cc.status_id
    INNER JOIN char_info ON char_info.movie_id = cc.movie_id
    INNER JOIN movie_info ON movie_info.movie_id = cc.movie_id
)
SELECT character_name, rating, complete_hero_movie
FROM char_info
JOIN complete_hero_movies ON char_info.movie_id = complete_hero_movies.movie_id
